title: Royal Theater Carré
scope: The standing Royal Theatre Carré, including its neo-Renaissance Amstel facade, bowed zinc roof, central roof lantern, stage tower and attached rear ranges.
limitations: The decorative capitals and balustrades are simplified, and the rear glazing and services use architectural estimates.
Terrain and the model cover the building and its immediate site. The canal locks, nearby houses and temporary signs are outside the scope.
